title: Deformity Consultation Console model pack
description: A self-contained description of the variables to collect and the models to fit them to. The console holds no models of its own; a pack is the whole of its clinical content.

id.description: Stable identifier. Saved cases record it so a case is never silently scored by a different pack.

version.description: Bump on any coefficient change. It is printed on every patient report.

population.description: Who the models were fitted on. Printed on the patient report.

validationStatus.description: Anything other than the first three marks the pack as a demonstration: the console then bars it from clinical framing and watermarks every report SPECIMEN.

report.description: Plain-language text for the patient-facing document.

naturalHistory.description: What is known about the course without surgery. Say plainly if the pack cannot speak to it.

variableGroups.description: Sections of the consultation form, rendered in the order given.

id.description: Referenced by model terms and expressions.

derivationRange.description: The range actually present in the derivation cohort. A case outside it is flagged in the form and on every prediction card as an extrapolation.

reference.description: Value of a typical derivation-cohort case. Used only to make the driver chart interpretable; never substituted for a missing value. Defaults to the midpoint of derivationRange, false, or the first option.

modifiable.description: Shows the variable on the What-would-change-it screen, in the patient's column or the surgeon's.

optimized.description: The value the what-if screen moves this variable to.

derived.description: Values computed from other variables (PI minus LL, unit conversions, ratios). Shown read-only on the form and usable in model terms.

expression.description: Arithmetic over variable ids. See the expression grammar in docs/MODEL_PACK_GUIDE.md.

mcid.description: Documentation of the minimal clinically important differences the outcome definitions rest on.

shortLabel.description: Used in the readout panel and the what-if table headers.

kind.description: Drives colour, wording and which section of the patient report the estimate lands in.

baselineRate.description: Observed event rate in the derivation cohort. Drawn beside the estimate so a number can be read against its base rate.

intercept.description: Not used by cox models, whose baseline is carried by baselineSurvival.

sigma.description: Linear models: residual standard deviation. Without it no interval and no threshold probabilities are shown.

thresholds.description: Linear models: levels whose probability of being reached is worth stating.

horizonMonths.description: Cox models: the time the reported risk refers to.

lpMean.description: Cox models: mean linear predictor in the derivation cohort, which baselineSurvival is centred on. Defaults to 0.

recalibration.description: Applied to the linear predictor before the link, for fitting a published model to local outcomes.

expr.description: An arithmetic expression, for interactions and anything the transforms do not cover.

label.description: How this term is named in the driver chart. Write it for a clinician, not for the model file.

level.description: transform "level": the categorical value this indicator stands for.

basis.description: Which restricted cubic spline basis this coefficient belongs to, 1 to k-2.

performance.description: Printed under every estimate. A pack that omits it asks to be trusted without evidence.

validation.description: How it was validated: apparent, bootstrap-corrected, split-sample, external cohort.

patient.description: The words used on the patient report. Write them at reading age 12: no odds, no relative risks, no jargon.

positive.description: Completes: "About N in 100 patients with this profile ..."

exampleCase.description: Values loaded when the pack opens, so the console shows what it does rather than an empty shell. Never a real patient.
